name: Ànyán no Shénzú Ove: Fēng zhī Zhāng
summary: What was thought to be a simple investigation into the return of the demon clan turns out to be connected to a battle from five years ago. Even more unexpectedly, it also ties into a demonic realm rebellion from twenty years prior — and to a distant past — with the most shocking turn of events yet to come...
